args.title: Fix "Malformed row" error message to clarify column mismatch
args.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

The error message for row shape mismatches is unclear and does not specify that the issue is a column count mismatch. Update it to explicitly state that the number of columns in the row does not match the header, which will help users diagnose the problem more easily. This aligns with the reported issue where users are seeing this error despite their files being valid in spreadsheets.
